Name: Multi-User Chests
Author: MindMeltMax
Description:
[size=4][b]Description : 
[/b][/size]This mod will allow 2+ people to access a chest at once.
It's a bit buggy when multiple people try to change the color, but that's not what it's made for.

[size=4][b]Installation : 
[/b][/size]1. Install [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]Smapi[/url]﻿
2. Unzip file and place in mod folder
3. You can now steal your friends stuff while he's still in his chest... yay

[b][size=3]Also : 
[/size][/b]For the mod to work properly, each party must have it installed

[b][size=4]Update 1.0.2 :[/size]
[/b]Changed something minor which should improve mod compatibility
